name: Proschalnoje pis'mo
source: The story is inspired by the history of Imperial Yuryev University. Scattered throughout the game are hidden “easter eggs” — click on them to uncover fascinating facts about Voronezh State University and its people.
translation: 这个故事的灵感来自帝国尤里耶夫大学的历史。游戏中散布着隐藏的“复活节彩蛋”——点击它们即可发现有关沃罗涅日州立大学及其人民的有趣事实。
